notes.title: [Update] Version 2.0.0 is now available.
notes.content:
Alice49 Episode 0 - Dear customers who purchased "Diamonds and Cream Puffs

Thank you for playing "Alice49".
We have taken your comments and suggestions into consideration,
We have updated the game to improve the usability of the playing environment.

[h3]**Notes***[/h3]
This update is a fundamental system modification.
[u]By applying this version, you will not be able to use the save data that you have been using so far,[/u]We apologize for the inconvenience, but if you wish to apply this version,
If you choose "From the beginning" and overwrite the old saved data with the new saved data, please delete the saved data,

[h3]◆Update[/h3]
＜System: Reasoning Section＞
[list]
[*] Implementation of a "Back" button that allows you to return to the previous page.
[*] Implementation of a "Back" button that allows you to return to the previous page when you open the D-Note.
[*] "Open D-Note" button is implemented in the logic key selection part after selecting keywords.
　└ This allows you to delete keywords and use the table of contents function after selecting keywords.
[*] Implementation of the name of the Chapter currently being read.
[/list]

＜System: General＞
[list]
[*] Implement "SAVE/LOAD" button in the character drama part and the mystery part.
 　└Remove "SAVE/LOAD" button from the D-Note screen.
[*] Added a simple operation explanation screen at the start of the game
[*] Localization of the English version is now supported.
[/list]

[h3]◆Fixed bugs[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a problem in which the number of logic keys retrieved was not correct when deleting some logic keys.
[*] Fixes to scenario flaws in the deduction section.
[*] Fixes to typographical errors
[/list]

We would appreciate it if you could continue to provide us with your comments and suggestions in your reviews.
